title: Grateful Dead Live at The Palestra, U. of Rochester on 1970-11-20
lineage: AUD > MR > PCM > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Good‑energy 1970 audience tape featuring a standout Good Lovin' and Jorma’s guest jam; listenable despite cassette cuts.
ai_review.review: The recording captures an energetic 1970 Rochester show where the Dead delivered tight, full‑bodied performances and a memorable last‑set jam with guest guitarist Jorma Kaukonen. While the audience tape suffers from noticeable drop‑outs, reel‑flips and missing sections in the late set, reviewers find it surprisingly listenable and worth revisiting for its unique guest moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance (4‑5 stars) while noting recording imperfections; weighted scoring yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience cassette source with second/third‑generation copies, significant drop‑outs and cuts especially in the late set, but overall clear enough to be enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard '70 interpretations with three electric sets; the final set features a high‑energy guest jam that reviewers highlight as a major attraction.
